_help: Amazon Associates picks for the home page 'Wig-day essentials on Amazon' section. Every link is built as https://www.amazon.com/s?k=<query>&tag=<tag>, so the tag below is added automatically. To change a tile, edit its name, blurb or query (the Amazon search words). To add one, copy a tile and pick an icon: stand, bonnet, cap, glue, tint, wash, heat, brush. To link one exact product instead of a search, add "url" with your SiteStripe link (it must already contain tag=get786-20). Do not add prices or copied product photos: Amazon only allows those from its own tools (SiteStripe / Product Advertising API). Rebuild with: node scripts/build.mjs. Rules: https://affiliate-program.amazon.com/help/operating/agreement
disclosure: As an Amazon Associate I earn from qualifying purchases.
